scope: Instrumentation diagnostic only. No candidate, timing comparison, performance or RSS claim. Counts and buffer byte lengths describe setup work, not peak memory. Each board gets a fresh process; Observer records retain scalar metadata only; a WeakMap maps solver identities to record indices. No post-setup public step calls are counted separately from already-solved/failed-at-setup cases; no solver liveness inference. Each board first gets a fresh uninstrumented correctness reference on the same CPU; instrumentation must preserve all five hashes and routing work/counts.
